title: Wonderful experience
text: Small intermit venue with no more than about 15 people the show was breathtaking , passionate and was totally authentic, the tapas and sangria was lovely , the whole show last about 1 hour and it goes so quick , this was the first time I’d experienced  flamenco and would definitively see it again an absolute work of art well done
author: Matthew_D

title: Flamenco: soul of Seville.
text: We do not know if this is the best venue to listen to or watch a Flamenco show in Seville, but we really liked Casa Duende Tablao for the intimate atmosphere, the proximity to the stage and for the artists who performed, and therefore we highly recommend it! Ticket price in line with others viewed. If we can make a suggestion, a drink should be included in the ticket price.  In any case: a must-see!
author: AntonioS111

title: Casa Duende, the best tablao experience in Seville
text: A year after its opening, Casa Duende continues to leave a mark every time I visit it. The experience is very good; the charm of the place, the intimacy, and a good show make the "duende" come out every night.

title: Incredibly gripping and beautifully entertaining, Flamenco, Guitarist and Singer
text:
Absolutely enchanting, so moving and atmospheric. Exceeded our expectations and in such a perfectly intimate venue. 
Bold, elegant, engaging and fully recommend this show - excellent value and wonderful customer service for drinks and small tapas plates.

title: Intimate venue, big entertainment!
text: The show was fabulous!  Guitar player and singer were the perfect accompaniment to the lithe dancer whose energy was electric.

title: Excellent Show and Highly Recommended
text:

title: Great experience
text: This was one of the best flamenco shows I've experienced. The 3 artists were amazing and great to watch and listen to. If you want an authentic flamenco this is it. Very intimate setting, friendly staff, good small bar too. Definitely recommend.

title: Incredible!
text: Incredible show! €25 per person for a hour-long show in a small theatre for a small crowd. Staff is incredibly friendly and helpful.
